options.title: The Virgin Adoring the Host
options.visualAssessment: Exact Met object 2005.186, Ingres 1852, verified against museum object page and matching image. Small jewel-like devotional painting, Virgin in saturated blue and red adoring the Host over a chalice, flanked by two saints. Exceptionally controlled contours, solemn and highly legible frontal composition; strong Eucharistic devotion candidate. Subject is Marian adoration of Host, not a generic exposition or monstrance scene. Met labels original Public Domain; final image acquisition, crop and user artistic acceptance remain outstanding.

options.title: The Glory of Saints

options.title: Saint James the Greater
options.visualAssessment: Rubens dynamic half-length figure with strong red cloak and facial presence; directly named apostle and cohesive cycle; portrait without historical likeness claim.

options.title: Saint John the Evangelist
options.visualAssessment: Richly modeled, full-bodied Saint John Evangelist holding chalice against deep dark background; visually coherent with James and Bartholomew in the Prado Rubens apostolate.

options.title: Saint Philip
options.visualAssessment: Rubens Saint Philip: visually matched composition with cross, blue-grey cloak, tightly concentrated elderly figure and deep shadow; consistent painterly force with Prado apostolate. Third-party matched preview plus exact Prado inventory; source identity confirmed, release and crop outstanding.

options.title: Saint Bartholomew
options.visualAssessment: Rubens expressive Bartholomew with dark green cloak and luminous face; convincingly painterly, clear solo apostle identity.

options.title: Saint Thomas
options.visualAssessment: Rubens's Saint Thomas: monumental half-length elder, intensely modeled head and flowing beard, dark background, deep blue drapery and open book; exact Prado painting image matched. Strong coherence with the Prado apostolate; no user acceptance or rights clearance.

options.title: Saint James the Less
options.visualAssessment: Rubens's Saint James the Less: forceful cloaked elder in ochre against a subdued background, substantial modelling and clear silhouette, holding his traditional attribute. Matched Prado exact painting preview, frame included only in preview; crop and rights not assessed.

options.title: Saint Simon
options.visualAssessment: Rubens's Saint Simon: strong profile of silver-haired elder bent over open book, violet-grey robe and black background; excellent concentrated portrait. Matched Prado exact painting preview; no approval for home or publication.

options.title: Saint Mark and Saint Luke
options.visualAssessment: Juan Ribalta Saint Mark and Saint Luke: verified exact Prado painting preview (not the Matthew/John companion). Restrained earthy chiaroscuro and an evocative dual-evangelist composition, but considerably underlit and diffuse; shared two-person scene risks weak recognition on small saint cards. Secondary contextual use only pending better colour/resolution inspection. Both subject records refer to the SAME painting, not individual portraits.
